status_definitions.production_live: Publicly reachable and operated by an automated production workflow.
status_definitions.published_static: Published and usable as static files or generated pages; not a hosted transactional service.
status_definitions.verification_ready: Built and inspectable, but its strongest credibility claim still awaits outside use or review.
status_definitions.configured_not_adopted: Operational machinery exists, but CEL has not verified external adoption.
status_definitions.local_only: Implemented for local verification only; no public network deployment is claimed.

capabilities.name: Public evidence archive
capabilities.claim: A public static archive exposes 4,000 event records, institution pages, source metadata, limitations, and correction routes.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Record count measures published documentation, not incident prevalence, school quality, safety, or independent verification.

capabilities.name: Certification and cell-level provenance
capabilities.claim: Deterministic gates certify source locators and record support for 3,810 records; a separate quality audit still marks 3,908 records as needing internal review.

metrics.label: ED rows with matched workbook provenance

capabilities.claim_boundary: Certification is a deterministic support-and-provenance gate. It is not equivalent to completed human review or outside validation.

capabilities.name: Research exports and static API
capabilities.claim: Snapshot-bound JSON, CSV, research exports, schemas, and versioned static API files are publicly downloadable.
capabilities.claim_boundary: The v1 API is a static public-data interface, not a continuously queried application server.

capabilities.name: CEL Signals accountability engine
capabilities.claim: An autonomous engine compiles evidence-bounded Signals, publishes to Bluesky, exposes RSS/JSON, and persists distribution state with safety and withdrawal controls.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Operational publication does not itself demonstrate reporting reuse, institutional response, audience conversion, or other downstream impact.

capabilities.name: External review infrastructure
capabilities.claim: CEL publishes bounded reviewer packets and review instructions, but records no completed external review or approved public acknowledgment.
capabilities.claim_boundary: A review packet is infrastructure for review. It is not evidence that review occurred or that a reviewer endorsed CEL.

capabilities.name: Partner syndication and outreach
capabilities.claim: Duplicate-controlled partner outreach and feed proposals are implemented; CEL currently publishes no verified subscription, embed, webhook, or reuse adoption.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Configured outreach capacity is not a partnership, adoption, citation, or impact outcome.

capabilities.name: Snapshot registry smart contract
capabilities.claim: A minimal owner-controlled Solidity registry can attest snapshot hashes in local tests; CEL claims no public-chain deployment.
capabilities.claim_boundary: Local contract code and tests do not establish decentralization, immutability of CEL's source data, public-chain deployment, or third-party use.
